taxonomies.name: Color Characteristics
taxonomies.definition: Visual color properties including variety, intensity, and appearance of arts and crafts materials, e.g. color selection range, brightness levels

taxonomies.name: Ergonomic Features
taxonomies.definition: Physical design elements that affect handling and user comfort, e.g. grip surfaces, holding mechanisms

taxonomies.name: Physical Structure and Integrity
taxonomies.definition: Physical form, construction quality, and structural soundness of arts and crafts products and their packaging, e.g. pencil straightness, box construction durability, shape distortion, container lid mechanisms

taxonomies.name: Writing Tip Durability
taxonomies.definition: Physical condition and performance characteristics of pencil, marker, or crayon tips during use, e.g. tip breakage resistance, sharpness retention, point wear patterns

taxonomies.name: Product Size Specifications
taxonomies.definition: Physical measurements and dimensional properties of arts and crafts items, e.g. container volume capacity, item proportions for different age groups, length and width specifications

taxonomies.name: Material Safety Properties
taxonomies.definition: Chemical composition and safety characteristics of arts and crafts materials, e.g. allergen content levels, toxicity ratings, ingredient safety profiles

taxonomies.name: Tactile Surface Quality
taxonomies.definition: Physical texture and feel characteristics of arts and crafts materials during handling, e.g. smoothness consistency, softness levels, surface texture quality
